name: Ya khochu umeret
source:
A story about how the "harem" ending of ES could have ended. Semyon is left alone, and all he wants is to die.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2715669086]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一个关于ES的“后宫”结局如何结束的故事。只剩下谢苗一个人，他只想死。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2715669086]Steam[/url]]
